quiz.title: Unit 3 FRQ 3: Symbolic manipulations (Topics 3.8 to 3.15)
quiz.headline: Solve trigonometric equations, rewrite expressions with identities, evaluate an inverse composition, and solve an inequality, all with exact values.
quiz.promptTitle: Free response 3 · Symbolic manipulations · no calculator
quiz.prompt: Directions: Answer each part using exact values. For parts A and C (ii), give all solutions in the interval 0 ≤ x < 2π.
quiz.instructions: Part B style: no calculator is allowed. Angle measures are in radians. Unless otherwise specified, the domain of a function f is the set of all real numbers x for which f(x) is a real number. Solutions to equations must be real numbers. Determine the exact value of any expression that can be obtained without a calculator, such as sin(π/6) or arccos(1/2). Show the work that leads to your answers.
quiz.note: Original practice question written in the AP Precalculus free-response format (6 points, parts A to C). Scoring is self-assessed with the point-by-point rubric. It is not an official AP question or an official AP score.

scaffold.label: Show work
scaffold.text: Write the setup, such as the expression you evaluate or the equation you solve, before the answer.

scaffold.label: Use exact values
scaffold.text: Without a calculator, give exact values such as √3/2 or 7π/6, not decimals.

scaffold.label: Justify
scaffold.text: When a part says give a reason or explain, refer to the graph, the given values, or the context.

responseFields.label: Part A (i)
responseFields.prompt: A (i). Solve 2 sin²x − sin x − 1 = 0 for 0 ≤ x < 2π.
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

responseFields.label: Part A (ii)
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

responseFields.label: Part B (i)
responseFields.prompt: B (i). Rewrite h(x) = (1 − cos²x)/(sin x · cos x) as a single trigonometric function of x, without fractions.
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

responseFields.label: Part B (ii)
responseFields.prompt: B (ii). Rewrite k(x) = cos(x + π/3) as an expression of the form A cos x + B sin x, where A and B are exact constants.
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

responseFields.label: Part C (i)
responseFields.prompt: C (i). Find the exact value of sin(arccos(−3/5)).
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

responseFields.label: Part C (ii)
responseFields.prompt: C (ii). Solve 2 sin x + 1 > 0 for 0 ≤ x < 2π. Express your answer using interval notation.
responseFields.placeholder: Show the work that leads to your answer, then state the answer with any units or notation the part asks for.

rubric.label: A (i) Solutions
rubric.guidance: Earn the point for x = π/2, 7π/6, and 11π/6, from (2 sin x + 1)(sin x − 1) = 0. All three are needed.

rubric.label: A (ii) Solutions
rubric.guidance: Earn the point for x = π/6, 5π/6, 7π/6, and 11π/6, from cos(2x) = 1/2 with 0 ≤ 2x < 4π. All four are needed.

rubric.label: B (i) Single function
rubric.guidance: Earn the point for h(x) = tan x, with work such as (1 − cos²x)/(sin x cos x) = sin²x/(sin x cos x) = sin x/cos x.

rubric.label: B (ii) Sum identity
rubric.guidance: Earn the point for k(x) = (1/2)cos x − (√3/2)sin x.

rubric.label: C (i) Exact value
rubric.guidance: Earn the point for 4/5, with the reasoning that arccos(−3/5) is an angle in [0, π], where sine is not negative.

quiz.modelResponse:
A (i). Factor: (2 sin x + 1)(sin x − 1) = 0. So sin x = −1/2, giving x = 7π/6 and 11π/6, or sin x = 1, giving x = π/2.

A (ii). cos(2x) = 1/2. Since 0 ≤ x < 2π, 0 ≤ 2x < 4π, so 2x = π/3, 5π/3, 7π/3, 11π/3. Then x = π/6, 5π/6, 7π/6, 11π/6.

B (i). By the Pythagorean identity, 1 − cos²x = sin²x. So h(x) = sin²x/(sin x cos x) = sin x/cos x = tan x, for x where sin x ≠ 0 and cos x ≠ 0.

B (ii). cos(x + π/3) = cos x cos(π/3) − sin x sin(π/3) = (1/2)cos x − (√3/2)sin x.

C (i). Let θ = arccos(−3/5). Then cos θ = −3/5 and θ is in [0, π], so sin θ ≥ 0. sin θ = √(1 − 9/25) = 4/5.

C (ii). 2 sin x + 1 > 0 means sin x > −1/2. sin x = −1/2 at x = 7π/6 and 11π/6, and sin x < −1/2 between them. So the solution is [0, 7π/6) ∪ (11π/6, 2π).
quiz.alternateModel: In A (i) you may substitute u = sin x and solve 2u² − u − 1 = 0 first. In C (i) a right triangle with adjacent side −3 and hypotenuse 5 in Quadrant II gives the same value, 4/5.
commonErrors: Dropping the solution x = π/2 from the factor sin x − 1.
Solving 2x = π/3 and 5π/3 only, which misses half of the solutions of A (ii).
Writing 1 − cos²x = sin x, without the square.
Using a plus sign in the cosine sum identity.
Giving −4/5 in C (i), ignoring that arccosine returns an angle in [0, π].
Writing the inequality's solution as 7π/6 < x < 11π/6, which is where 2 sin x + 1 < 0.
